questions.q: What is the capital of France?
questions.explain: Paris has been the capital of France since the late 10th century.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explain: Mars appears red due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.q: What is the largest mammal in the world?
questions.explain: The blue whale can grow up to 100 feet long and weigh up to 200 tons.

questions.q: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explain: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Japan in September.

questions.q: What is the chemical symbol for Gold?
questions.explain: Au comes from the Latin word 'aurum', meaning gold.

questions.q: What is the smallest prime number?
questions.explain: 2 is the smallest and only even prime number.

questions.q: Which gas do plants primarily absorb from the atmosphere?
questions.explain: Plants absorb CO2 during photosynthesis to produce glucose and oxygen.
